title: Rethinking the AI Scientist: Interactive Multi-Agent Workflows for Scientific Discovery

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis and literature review assessing how the system's exclusive reliance on open-access literature systematically underrepresents research from lower- and middle-income countries.

Conceptual evaluation discussing how prohibitive article processing charges and subscription paywalls exclude specific research, skewing the AI's knowledge base toward institutions with greater financial resources.

Analysis of bibliometric literature to demonstrate how the reliance on open-access content disproportionately impacts certain scientific fields based on varying open-access publishing rates (e.g., high in astronomy, low in chemical engineering).
